clayresearch.delta: Idempotent state transitions must bind semantic request identity; identifier equality alone is insufficient for replay-safe loop/state execution.

frank.delta: FRANK replay/recovery contracts must distinguish identical retry from same-ID changed semantic intent; no live-FRANK claim advances.

gwt.delta: No GWT claim-state change; later WorkspaceEpisode/re-entry replay should consume adjudicated ledger identities.

emergenz.delta: No emergence inference; this is a persistence/replay correctness counterexample only.

claycode.delta: ClayCode transaction/replay semantics need a canonical semantic request identity distinct from execution-local metadata; stage semantic-ID work is directionally compatible but does not itself fix H-WP-02.

claygraph.delta: No graph claim-state change; graph/run identities must not be used as a substitute for ledger request equivalence.

unifieddb.delta: Unified transaction/idempotency semantics must compare canonical request identity before returning replay; same key/event ID with changed semantics is a conflict, not a replay hit.

harness.delta: H-WP-02 current visible replay decision is under-specified. Red probe and local fix work have been added; H-WP-02 remains incomplete and H1 remains blocked on BASE.

shared_ancestry: All feedback derives from the same repo/current-code lineage plus one synthetic mechanism probe; it is not independent replication.
